# Version 4.151.0
> **Skia m151 with a performance sweep** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 moves the engine to Skia m151 and ports several hot paths to allocation-free managed code. This release adds Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM libraries for .NET 11, fixes a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData, and optimizes color conversion, HarfBuzz buffer encoding, and span-based glyph reading.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia bumped to milestone m151** — Updates Skia to milestone m151 and merges several rounds of upstream m151 bug fixes. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312))

## API Surface

- **SKColor hex parsing gains Span overloads** — Adds ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads for SKColor hex parsing and optimizes the parsing path. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native resource leak fixed** — Fixes a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI). ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))
- **CPU raster regression restored** — Restores SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT to fix a CPU raster regression introduced upstream. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Hot paths ported to managed C# and made allocation-free** — SKColor to SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply now run in managed integer math, HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8 and Tag.Parse avoid per-call allocations, SKFourByteTag.Parse drops a per-call char[4] allocation, and SKShaper reads glyph results via zero-copy spans. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385), [#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388))
- **Unnecessary unsafe modifier removed** — Removes an unnecessary unsafe modifier from GRContextOptions. ([#3991](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3991))

## Platform

- **Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM libraries for .NET 11** — Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries built with the new exnref exception handling for .NET 11 WASM, plus a preview-.NET WASM test job to catch exception-handling regressions. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Makes Buffer.AddUtf8(string) allocation-free via pooled UTF-8 encoding and removes a per-call char[4] allocation in Tag.Parse, alongside the Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM library update.
